key: It seems to be just an ordinary box...
en: It seems to be just an ordinary box...
ja: ただの　ふつうの　箱のようだ……
箱め　なんで　こんなことを!?

key: Overcome the box... Be faster, smarter, stronger than the box.
en: Overcome the box... Be faster, smarter, stronger than the box.
ja: 箱を　乗りこえろ……箱より　速く　賢く　強くなれ

key: I think I had too much to drink, and I didn't even drink anything today...
en: I think I had too much to drink, and I didn't even drink anything today...
ja: 飲みすぎたみたいだ。今日は何も飲んでないってのに…
ウルフ: うわ、マジかよ…

key: I could've just sworn I saw a box walk through here.\nFourth one this week.
en: I could've just sworn I saw a box walk through here.\nFourth one this week.
ja: たしかに　箱が　ここを　歩いていった気が　したんだ\n今週　これで　4つ目だぞ
